round_purpose: Post-A0I future-sensitivity reuse study. A0J-P0 = bounded shared-prefix profiler + production cost accounting (attribution only). A0J-P1 = cached future sensitivity p_tau + fresh current AdamW action injection G_t (CACHE_P) vs EXACT fresh-p vs direct STALE_W, cache ages {1,2,4}, on pre-exposed dev trajectories only. This is the first round that modifies the controller COMPUTATION STRUCTURE (future-sensitivity refresh policy); it is a dev approximation study, NOT a new independent utility acceptance and NOT closed-loop training.

phase_structure.A0J_P0: bounded shared-prefix profiler + production cost accounting; pre-registered branch gate S_upper >= 1.25 decides full P1 vs early-stop (one-anchor CACHE_P correctness smoke only, status CACHE_ROUTE_LOW_ENGINEERING_LEVERAGE)
phase_structure.A0J_P1: full study ONLY IF P0 gate passes: implementation gate (apply_Gt_T reproduces production w/scores/chosen-id), three-way exact/cache/stale comparison, cache ages {1,2,4}, dev replay utility retention, engineering cost accounting, Kr/Ks COST_PROJECTION_ONLY

frozen_science_semantics.state: z_t = (theta_t, m_t, v_t) joint AdamW state; t = optimizer step index
frozen_science_semantics.p_t_definition: p_t = full H-step future lookahead back-propagated to just AFTER the action step = the 3-channel cotangent with respect to z_(t+1) (theta,m,v channels); in the frozen shared-adjoint walk it is the cotangent INPUT to the k=1 (pending-step) reverse adjoint iteration
frozen_science_semantics.G_t_definition: G_t = d z_(t+1) / d g_t, the raw-gradient action-injection Jacobian of the pending native step (post-unscale/pre-clip pulse semantics, frozen)
frozen_science_semantics.w_t: w_t = G_t^T p_t (candidate-independent shared direction; frozen production w_0)
frozen_science_semantics.candidates: a_j(t) = g_j(t) - g_t for j=1..M=4 hash-group data-reweighting candidate gradients; j=0 no-op a_0 = 0; candidate batches are the frozen per-stream-seed deterministic candidate batches (same batches at every age; candidate gradients are ALWAYS recomputed at current theta_t - caching old candidate gradients is FORBIDDEN)
frozen_science_semantics.scores: h_j = w^T a_j(t); h_0 = 0 exactly; predicted_delta_j = lambda*h_j; lambda = 0.05
frozen_science_semantics.selector: argmin_j (predicted_delta_j, action_id) over j=0..4, exact tie -> lowest id; no-op is a legal action
frozen_science_semantics.single_frozen_scorer: ALL three arms (EXACT/CACHE_P/STALE_W) are scored by the SAME frozen FULL_GRAD_DOT candidate scorer on the SAME g_t and SAME g_j(t) computed once per aged unit; A0I directional (JVP) scoring is NOT introduced this round

three_arms.EXACT: w_exact(t) = G_t^T p_t with fresh H=4 lookahead from the true current z_t (frozen production shared-adjoint path)
three_arms.CACHE_P: w_cache(t) = G_t^T p_tau with anchor-cached p_tau but CURRENT-step snapshot for G_t (fresh raw gradient, fresh m_t/v_t, fresh optimizer internal step, fresh LR, fresh bias correction, fresh clipping state/norm, fresh parameter-group hyperparameters); reusing G_tau is FORBIDDEN
three_arms.STALE_W: w_stale(t) = w_tau = G_tau^T p_tau, the anchor's full w reused verbatim

frozen_science_semantics.error_decomposition_context: w_exact - w_stale = G_t^T(p_t - p_tau) + (G_t - G_tau)^T p_tau; w_exact - w_cache = G_t^T(p_t - p_tau). CACHE_P removes the second term, but the two stale-w error terms can cancel - superiority is an empirical question, not assumed.
frozen_science_semantics.primary_accuracy_metric: pairwise action-gap error gap_error_(j,l) = (w_approx - w_exact)^T (a_j - a_l); vector cosine is SECONDARY DIAGNOSTIC ONLY and must never gate cache acceptance; the acceptance-relevant quantity is chosen-id preservation and DeltaGain, not cosine

frozen_this_round_NOT_modified: action injection position (post-unscale/pre-clip, one optimizer step)
future minibatch generation semantics (frozen stream manifests)
forbidden_this_round: new independent acceptance batch / new training seed / new long checkpoint training
using V_eval to tune cache age or any threshold
reusing G_tau for the CACHE_P arm
opening any other method branch based on profiler results (FD-HVP / multi-score averaging / vector-JVP are next-step branches ONLY)
only_variable_changed: future-sensitivity refresh policy (fresh p_t vs cached p_tau vs cached w_tau), studied on pre-exposed dev trajectories; the controller is never applied continuously to change a trajectory

trajectory_construction.baseline: from anchor z_tau, a fixed no-op native training trajectory z_tau -> ... -> z_(tau+4) on the frozen stream; used ONLY to develop/measure cache drift; the cache controller is NEVER applied continuously (no closed-loop distribution shift mixing)
trajectory_construction.future_batches: frozen stream manifests already cover >= 16 micro-batches (8 optimizer steps); the maximum window (age 4 + H 4 lookahead = stream horizons 5..8) is covered by the frozen manifests; NO new batches are generated
trajectory_construction.fresh_lookahead_per_age: at t = tau+k the pending native step is stream horizon k+1 and the fresh H=4 lookahead covers stream horizons k+1..k+4

p0_profiler_spec.tool: torch.profiler (bounded, one exact decision pass on one anchor-stream) for ATTRIBUTION + no-profiler CUDA-event stage timing (warmup 1, >=5 timed repeats, interleaved order, same GPU/state/stream) for PRODUCTION numbers
components: B baseline H-step future lookahead (per horizon)
E reverse future adjoint split per step into E1 optimizer-local analytic VJP / E2 clipping VJP / E3 curvature-HVP / E4 precision-backend conversion (probe)
I audit/logging/hash/serialization (listed separately, NEVER counted as production scientific compute)

p0_branch_gate_prefixed.T_total_exact: current full actionable exact decision cost (production one-shot: restore + pending fwd/bwd + candidates + refresh prefix + scoring), measured no-profiler
p0_branch_gate_prefixed.T_recomputable_prefix: B+C+D+E only (baseline lookahead + endpoint forward+gradient + reverse adjoint); candidate scoring NOT included; G_t^T p_t (F) still runs on cached steps and is NOT part of the skippable prefix
p0_branch_gate_prefixed.S_upper: T_total_exact / (T_total_exact - T_recomputable_prefix) = theoretical speedup upper bound if the prefix were free
p0_branch_gate_prefixed.gate: if S_upper < 1.25 -> early stop: one-anchor CACHE_P correctness smoke only, status CACHE_ROUTE_LOW_ENGINEERING_LEVERAGE, no full P1 utility matrix; else full A0J-P1
p0_branch_gate_prefixed.note: the 25% gate is a resource-branching rule for this round only, NOT a paper significance standard

implementation_gate_prefixed.desc: before any cache conclusion, on dev: apply_Gt_T(snapshot, p_fresh) must reproduce the production inline w_exact of the SAME pass; report max abs score diff, 5-action rank agreement, chosen-id agreement per unit; tolerance atol32=1e-5 rtol32=1e-4 (frozen, copied from A0H20/A0I; may NOT be adjusted after viewing results); additionally the anchor exact pass scores must reproduce pe.run_adjoint_only production scores on the same unit
implementation_gate_prefixed.on_fail: CACHE_IMPLEMENTATION_GATE=FAIL -> stop P1 utility, deliver profiler + failed probe only

anchor_stream_selection_rule_prefixed.rule: deterministic, applied BEFORE viewing any A0J cache result: anchors = the 3 frozen A0H-1 diagnostics dev states (2031/52, 2034/64, 2036/76 = frozen a0g DEV_STATES; recorded as exposed in the A0H20 exposure ledger excluded_states list; early/middle/late steps 52/64/76, seeds 2031/2034/2036), streams = the two smallest stream_ids {0,1} per anchor -> 6 anchor-stream trajectories
anchor_stream_selection_rule_prefixed.continuity_note: same dev states as A0I-B so native-step and decision-cost references are directly comparable; dev-only, no acceptance identity; no state may be swapped based on cache performance
anchor_stream_selection_rule_prefixed.insufficient_data_policy: if eligible dev states were insufficient, shrink honestly and record; not applicable here (3 anchors x 2 streams available)

accuracy_metrics_prefixed.decision_preservation_primary: chosen_id_preservation_cache(age) and chosen_id_preservation_stalew(age) = fraction of the 6 anchor-stream units whose chosen_id equals EXACT; plus full 5-action ranking agreement
accuracy_metrics_prefixed.pairwise_gap_error: ALL pairs (j,l), j<l, over {0..4}: gap_exact, gap_cache, gap_stale, gap errors; record exact top1-top2 margin, cache/stale error on the exact top1-top2 pair, best-nonzero-vs-noop exact gap and corresponding cache/stale error; no-op a_0=0 genuinely included

utility_replay_prefixed.order: freeze exact/cache/stale chosen-ids to disk + SHA256 BEFORE any replay; replay afterwards; never use V_eval to alter choices; never drop mismatch units; no-op and harmful included
utility_replay_prefixed.per_aged_unit: replay j=0..4 all five actions once from z_(tau+k) with the action injected at the pending stream horizon k+1 (A0G frozen injection semantics), H=4 total steps (stream horizons k+1..k+4), dual endpoint labels V_score and V_eval at z_(tau+k+4) in the same pass
utility_replay_prefixed.identity: dev approximation utility retention evidence; NOT independent validation

separate: T_refresh (full fresh future sensitivity: lookahead B + endpoint C+D + reverse adjoint E + G_t^T p_t F)
T_selected_action_execution (honest reuse accounting: full-grad scorer already holds selected gradient)
two_framings: closed-loop marginal decision overhead (refresh/K_r + (score+execute+GtP)/K_s) labeled COST_PROJECTION_ONLY
cost_accounting_prefixed.kr_ks_claim_limit: cost arithmetic ONLY; no Kr/Ks combination may be claimed to have closed-loop utility; combinations not supported by the cache-age utility evidence must be marked COST_ONLY / UTILITY_NOT_VALIDATED
cost_accounting_prefixed.memory: cached p_theta/p_m/p_v bytes and cached w bytes from actual tensor nbytes (p ~ 3P, w ~ P, actual bytes authoritative)

retry_rule: retries allowed ONLY for infrastructure/serialization errors under the SAME manifest and SAME algorithm; any change to score semantics / cache rule / candidate / lambda, or any implementation change after viewing V_eval, exposes the current dev study and must be recorded as such - never disguised as the original pre-registered result; no environment upgrades; no killing external tasks; no commit/push/reset
environment: conda env fr_minimind, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 (physical GPU1, shared with external jobs - occupancy recorded), PYTHONPATH=research/src, torch 2.11.0, cuda:0 logical, bf16 autocast, math-SDPA HVP surrogate caveat inherited
early_stop_missing_p1_files_policy: if the P0 gate stops the round, P1 deliverables are explicitly marked NOT_COVERED - no fake empty results
no_single_composite_pass: final report outputs P0_PROFILE_COMPLETE, CACHE_IMPLEMENTATION_GATE, CACHE_DECISION_PRESERVATION per age, STALE_W_DECISION_PRESERVATION per age, CACHE_UTILITY_RETENTION per age, CACHE_COST_REDUCTION, CACHE_MEMORY_COST, EQUAL_WALLCLOCK_TRAINING_GAIN=NOT_TESTED as SEPARATE fields
